description:
Welcome to Suneli Valley - A Merck and Tuluri Brand

At Merck and Tuluri we're in the business of bringing exceptional gourmet foods and wines straight to your doorstep. We travel the world to find small-scale farmers and producers who are as passionate about their products as we are about discovering them. Our goal? To deliver unparalleled artisanal spices, foods, and beverages that are sustainably sourced and of the highest quality.

Our Brand: Suneli Valley

Through our brand, Suneli Valley, we've forged a special partnership with the people of Georgia. It's a place where the commitment to sustainable farming and foraging isn't just a practice; it's a way of life. This connection ensures that every product we bring to you is not only authentic but also contributes to the well-being of the local environment and its people.

Your Impact

Your support has a direct impact. The proceeds from our products go back into Georgia, helping to revitalize neglected farmlands and orchards. This initiative is at the heart of what we do, promoting sustainability and ensuring that our products contribute to a cycle of prosperity and renewal.

Why Choose Us?

Choosing to work with Merck and Tuluri means you're getting more than just great food and wine; you're supporting a network of global partnerships that value quality, sustainability, and community. Join us in celebrating the rich flavors and stories behind every product.

Suneli Valley Brand Ambassador Program Terms and Conditions

  1. Eligibility: To be part of the Suneli Valley Brand Ambassador Program, you must be at least 18 years old and maintain an active social media presence. By participating, you agree to these terms and conditions.

  2. Commission Structure: As a brand ambassador, you're entitled to earn commissions as follows:

    • 5% on orders up to $49.99.
    • 10% on orders from $50.00 to $99.99.
    • 12% on orders from $100.00 to $249.99.
    • 15% on orders over $250.00.

  3. Payment: Commissions are calculated monthly and paid within 30 days post-month-end via the program's chosen payment method (e.g., bank transfer, PayPal).

  4. Responsibilities and Conduct:

    • Promote Suneli Valley positively and professionally.
    • Use only approved marketing materials or obtain approval for your own materials that align with Suneli Valley's brand identity.
    • Transparently disclose your brand ambassador relationship.
    • Avoid any inappropriate, offensive, or illegal content in your promotions.
    • Do not engage in misleading or unethical advertising.

  5. Intellectual Property: You're granted a non-exclusive, revocable license to use Suneli Valley's provided promotional materials solely for brand promotion. Respect Suneli Valley's intellectual property rights at all times.

  6. Compliance and Engagement: Maintain active engagement with the program and comply with these terms. Failure to adhere may result in the revocation of your ambassador status.

  7. W-9 Form Submission: Complete a W-9 form for tax compliance.

  8. Term and Termination: This agreement is effective upon your acceptance and remains valid until terminated by either party. Notice of termination can be given by either party in writing at any time.

  9. Liability: Suneli Valley isn't liable for indirect, special, or consequential damages arising from this agreement or the ambassador program.

  10. Amendment: Suneli Valley may modify these terms and conditions, with continued participation post-modification indicating acceptance of the new terms.

  11. Governing Law: These terms are governed by the laws of the jurisdiction where Suneli Valley is registered, regardless of conflict of law principles.

By joining the Suneli Valley Brand Ambassador Program, you confirm that you've read, understood, and agreed to these terms and conditions.
